facets.description: utilities.js:182: Flat 10MB validation ignores max_attachment_size_kb, causing client/server disagreement for attachments.
utilities.js:180-186: Images accepted by the client can still exceed max_image_size_kb after five server downsizing attempts and be rejected.
utilities.js:183-184: The client advertises a 10240KB maximum that disagrees with the configured limits and server rejection messages.
utilities.js:243-249: The 413 error handler reports 10240KB regardless of the configured limit.
